package domain

import "time"

const HybridReplanPolicyVersion = "hybrid-replan-v1"

// Generation is a work watermark. A newer ingress cannot be cleared by an older claim.
type HybridEvaluationWork struct {
	LocalReason    string
	StudentID      string
	LearningPathID string
	Generation     int64
	ClaimToken     string
	LeaseUntil     time.Time
	LatestEvent    PlanningStateChangedEvent
	Targets        []HybridTargetRef
}
type HybridEvaluationJob struct {
	ID             string
	StudentID      string
	LearningPathID string
	SnapshotRef    string
	PolicyVersion  string
	Snapshot       HybridPlanningSnapshot
	CreatedAt      time.Time
}
